title: Marico expects 4700BC to break even ahead of schedule, two more digital brands to turn profitable in a year: Saugata Gupta
summary: Marico anticipates accelerated profitability for its digital-first brands, particularly 4700BC, expected to break even within a year. The company is expanding distribution channels for its premium foods and personal care products, focusing on urban general trade. Enhanced usage of technology and AI aims to improve sales efficiency and execution quality at the last mile. Internationally, Marico expects consistent growth across multiple markets following its successful strategies.

direction_reasons: TECHNOLOGY cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
